The '''Kor Vella mesa''' was a mesa on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The mesa was located at the center of the [[Vella plains]] and the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] was built atop the mesa.<ref name="SoF" />

==History==
Early in Corellia's history, intrepid explorers made their reputation by successfully scaling the Kor Vella mesa. The terrain was treacherous, and the area around the mesa boasted numerous predatory creatures. Those [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] who did manage to reach the mesa found that the bleak, weather-beaten landscape actually offered great solitude. The Kor Vella mesa became a site for introspection and meditation and a small religious sect later established a monastery on the mesa. After local miners located large deposits of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] near the mesa, the religious retreat quickly grew to become one of Corellia's most respected cities.<ref name="SWG:KV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Starting Location: "Kor Vella"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kor Vella mesa first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Its name was revealed in the description of the city of Kor Vella that was shown to players on the screen that allowed them to choose the starting location for a new character.<ref name="SWG:KV" /> These description texts were removed when [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] was made the starting city for all players with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]" on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
